notablePrerequisites: You have at least five creature cards in your graveyard.
description:
Activate Deathbloom Ritualist by tapping it, adding at least five mana of any color.
Activate Chrome Dome by paying {5}, creating a token copy of Sewer-veillance Cam.
When the Sewer-veillance Cam token enters, it triggers, untapping Deathbloom Ritualist.
Repeat.
